text:
I’m releasing my full video on why Mamdani is disbanding the NYPD’s Strategic Response Group and why after covering 100 protests in NYC that I think it’s part of his genius plan to win re-election. 

At an anti-ICE protest in New York, Nick Shirley got surrounded. I went in to see if he needed help but it was the SRG that could get him out safely. 

The same thing happened to me at the vigil for Ayatollah Khamenei in Washington Square Park. I went in to ask questions. In less than a minute, protesters were pushing me toward a wall. Police escorted me out.

Mamdani wants civilians from his own mayor’s office to be in charge of calling the police. This is the same mayor who wanted to defund the police and essentially has by canceling the hiring of 5000 new police officers. He also wants to de-escalate these protests with his dialogue coming from a guy who when asked whether Hamas should lay down its arms, said he didn’t really have an opinion about the future of Hamas.

In Paris I filmed businesses burned out after riots. I also saw what happened on streets where riot police were allowed to intervene. Riot police took care of business in Paris once they got the go ahead, the same go ahead that Adams gave riot police to end the Columbia encampments after they turned violent. Some students were even offered extra credit for participating in the encampemnt. 

Before Mamdani became mayor, Mamdani was shouting at Tom Homan and blocking a street with Jewish Voice for Peace outside Chuck Schumer’s home. He spent the night in jail. Now he's disbanding the very unit that arrested him, which doesn't seem like a coincidence. 

These protests disrupt New Yorkers and disbanding the riot police will only make it worse. I talked to a FedEx driver who couldn’t deliver his packages because the protests were blocking the street. I talked to an ambulance driver who couldn’t get his ambulance out because of a protest. I asked what happens if somebody in that building has a heart attack, he said "good luck." 

I’ve asked Mamdani supporters if they’d still vote for him if he couldn’t deliver on any of his promises. They told me yes. That’s what got me thinking about this election differently. He already has those votes. Now it's about pushing out the people who voted against him. 

Mamdani wants to abolish ICE. He says the NYPD won’t help with federal civil immigration enforcement.  He even urged private parking operators to deny ICE space for its operations. Imagine running a garage in New York and having the mayor tell you who he wants you to turn away. Conservatives don't want to live in a city that not only says they want to abolish ICE but is actually doing things to make their job harder. 

In Manhattan I found a mosque inside a halal-cart garage. New Yorkers stop me off camera to talk about the loud music they hear from carts on the streets all the time. And the city is making another 10,500 vendor licenses available starting in January. Conservatives don't want to live in a city that plays loud arabic music from halal carts. 

Mamdani wants city-owned grocery stores and he can use the money he would have used on adding 5,000 police officers to pay for those stores, in fact it can pay for 10 government grocery stores. Conservatives don't want to live in a city that prioritizes government owned grocery stores (a concept that has never worked) over hiring more police.

Look at the judges he’s keeping. Mamdani reappointed Judge Valentina Morales. The New York Post reported that in the first half of 2024 she released 83 of 101 defendants accused of violent felonies without bail. Conservatives don't want to live in a city that is soft on crime.

Mamdani wants another 2% tax on millionaires. The top 1% already pays about half of the city's taxes. So I asked what happens if those people take their businesses and leave. One guy told me we should take the business and run it ourselves. @camhigby asked who gets taxed after the rich leave. The person he interviewed said "the middle class." Conservatives don't want to live in a city that hates honest, ambitious, hard working people.

Mamdani’s own campaign called for shifting the property tax burden toward “richer and whiter neighborhoods.” His administration put out a racial equity plan aimed at closing racial wealth gaps, with a goal for NYPD recruitment to reflect the city’s demographics. I went to Brooklyn and asked people if we should just tax white people more, most said yes. Conservatives don't want to live in a city that advocates for taxing people based on race.

Finally, look at who he helps elect. Mamdani endorsed Darializa Avila Chevalier, who won her congressional primary. She said in 2019, “I forgot to get napkins so I just wiped my hand on the American flag behind me.” Conservatives don't want to be represented by people who hate America. 

Mamdani is significantly smarter than people give him credit for. If his goal is to get re-elected by any means possible, he's executing on that almost flawlessly. I wanted to do something different by sharing my thoughts on this because I've seen so much on the street and this decision from Mamdani truly crossed a line. New York has fallen but it can be restored. 

The best way to support my reporting is to subscribe here on X.

It's not simply a privacy coin or a mixer, but a complete product suite built around the new on-chain privacy protocol launched by Helius.

It solves the problem that Solana is completely transparent by default—anyone can see what your wallet bought, how much it sold, your holding history, etc.

RINGS is the platform's value-capture token, with fees flowing directly back to the token:
Fee flywheel: Launchpad-generated fees are currently split 50% buyback and burn + 50% injected into permanently locked RINGS liquidity, executed on-chain every 4 hours. Holding a certain value allows free listing of OTC blocks.

text:
❇️ BENCHMARKED: BISON-1, FULLY LOCAL. BEAT BASETEN’S HOSTED SCORE 

@baseten's groundhog-1’s 31B parameter sibling model, bison-1, now runs on my 64GB M5 Pro Mac mini, with the MLX port I made, quantized to 4-bit (16.1 GB instead of 60.9 GB)

- Scored 221/231 (95.7%) on JevBench. Baseten’s hosted API got 218/231 using the same questions
- Scored a perfect 48/48 on the easy JevBench questions and 72/72 on the original JevBench questions
- Got the same answer as Baseten’s hosted API (the only thing) on 29 of 30 questions (on the other question my Mac mini got the correct answer)
- Took 1.54 seconds (median over 20 runs) to make a decision (0.65 decisions per second).

All of this with my Mac mini doing other stuff at the same time!

bison-1 is a decision model based on Gemma 4 of @googlegemma with open weights released under permissive MIT and Apache 2.0 licenses that I can run on my own computer.

@baselabs
author: zeeshan_utd
quoted_text:
❇️ BENCHMARKED: GROUNDHOG-1, FULLY LOCAL. 30/30 MATCH WITH BASETEN.

I ran @baseten's new open-weight model, groundhog-1, locally on my 64GB M5 Pro Mac mini. It's a 26B model and open weights under permissive licenses (MIT and Apache 2.0)

Baseten released full-size weights for the model, so I made an MLX port and quantized it down to 4-bit (13.2 GB down from 49.5 GB)

Here are some numbers:
- 0.84 s per decision at ~513 tokens, median of 20 runs. That's 1.19 decisions per second
- All 20 runs were in the 0.82 to 0.87 s range
- I ran JevBench and got 206/231 (48/48 on the easy questions and 71/72 on the original set)
- My 4-bit quantized model got 30/30 of the same answers as Baseten's hosted model in my testing

That's with other stuff running on my Mac at the same time!

Really nice work from @baseten, @baselabs 💚

author: Kalshi

text:
SSD is about to become the only limiting factor for local AI

Most frontier open models are ultra sparse MoEs

Qwen 3.8 Flash Next = 180B total, ~6B active per token (~3%)
GLM 5.3 Flash = 321B total, ~18B active per token (~6%)
DeepSeek V4.1 Flash = 552B total, ~16B active per token (~3%)
GLM 5.3 = 753B total, ~40B active per token (~5%)
Kimi K3.1 Pro = 2.8T total, ~104B active per token (~4%)

When ~95% of a model sits idle on every token, keeping all of it in VRAM makes no sense

Local AI has been evolving toward this for years:

2023-2025 - Layer offloading (Ollama, classic llama.cpp)
This chopped whole layers across GPU and CPU, leaving the GPU waiting on CPU once VRAM filled up

Oct 2026 - RAM expert cache (llama.cpp --moe-cache)
This shifted from whole layers to individual experts, caching hot ones in VRAM and pulling misses from RAM. Huge leap for decode, but still capped at the size of your RAM

Now - SSD expert streaming
Early tools like Colibri and Strata proved direct NVMe streaming actually works on consumer hardware. Instead of hitting a VRAM or RAM wall, your SSD becomes an active part of the engine

However most people hear "run from SSD" and assume 2 tok/s, which isn't entirely wrong. A few problems still exist:

- Basic caching kicks out experts you're about to need again
- Waiting on disk reads one layer at a time leaves the GPU and SSD sitting idle
- Getting speculative decoding to work well with SSD streaming is hard
- Long prompts are tough to keep fast without wiping out your hot cache
- Most early tools are experimental engines built for only a couple models

Making expert streaming feel fast takes solving all of those together

At Magnitude, we've been working on this for the past 2 months. Here's how we solved it:

- Smarter caching that keeps your session's most-reused experts in GPU memory
- Speculative lookahead that pulls upcoming experts off SSD before the GPU needs them
- Direct NVMe reads scheduled across layers so your SSD never sits idle
- Streaming prefill that reads each cold expert once without wiping your hot cache
- Built into a full engine that tunes itself to your chip across Macs and GPUs

All of this together means DeepSeek V4.1 Flash on a single gaming GPU at ~40+ tok/s...

We're excited to release it on Monday
GitHub here: https://t.co/5SjPQWkmrF

text:
客观来说，当前的情况已经很坏了，还可以更坏吗？

更坏就是复刻2000的互联网泡沫。

当时的互联网泡沫里的基建泡沫大概是这样的：

需求端：VC投资的各种互联网初创公司，永远缺服务器缺光纤，重复给运营商下单，当VC不愿意投钱后，需求见顶，股价下跌，然后VC更不愿意投钱，直接死循环。

供给端：运营商以为需求很多，也在疯狂基建，结果有重复下单，需求端直接没了，运营商也开始砍单。泡沫破裂。

再看现在：

需求端：当期我们没有看到需求下降。这次AI的需求分两个方面，一个是B端、C端用AI的群体，另一边是AI模型公司和云厂商。

对于B端和C端用户，大家会不会因为股价下跌就不用AI，大概率不会；

云厂商是否会因为股价下跌，就暂停资本开支（有可能，因为股价下跌后股权融资的通道就基本关闭了，如果跌太多管理层会有压力，虽然过去几年亚马逊、谷歌的管理层没吃压力。新云的股权融资通道也基本关闭。）

供给端：晶圆厂、光模块、存储都在扩产，扩产落地大概在2027年底和2028年，从扩产惯性上来看晶圆厂最难掉头、其次是存储、最后是光模块。已经开始扩产的可能还得继续建，但在计划中的可能会停止。所以大概率情况是扩产继续，但速度比几个月前想的会慢一些？具体还得看四季度财报。

整体上来看，基本面上当前和一个月前其实没太大区别，唯一变了的就是股价，而股价下跌是否会导致需求端和供给端的变化，我觉得也挺不确定的。但市场习惯于线性外推。

text:
这几天看着比特币一泻千里的 K 线，我突然有一种特别熟悉的感觉，瞬间回到了 2022 年，也就是我刚入圈工作的那一年。

我还记得特别清楚，我刚进场的时候，比特币从六万一路快速下跌，五万、三万、两万，持续走熊。

但那个时候的我，越跌越兴奋。

我从入圈第一天就坚持定投，完整定投了一轮熊市，平均仓位价格是3万美金。

哪怕比特币从六万的高点，一路砸到一万六的历史大底，我没有丝毫绝望，反而特别开心能在熊市里捡到大把的低价筹码。

那个时候我读懂了一句话：熊市是送给新手的礼物。

但是，后来我又学会的第二句话：会买的是徒弟，会卖的才是师傅。

2025年这一轮牛市，我完美踩空了逃顶的机会，坐了财富过山车。

比特币冲到十二万高点的时候，我没有及时止盈，导致现金流一直很紧张。

如今行情从十二万一路回落跌到五万多，说实话，我现在的焦虑和恐慌，远远超过 2022 年。

时隔四年，行情再次重蹈覆辙，我的心态却彻底变了。

四年前我是空仓捡筹，现在我是满仓被套。

但越是这种极致恐慌的时刻，这种似曾相识的盘面，反而让我重新有了信心。

币圈每一轮周期，所有人都觉得 “这次不一样”。

但这么多年走下来，四年一轮的牛熊周期，从来没有被打破过。

按照周期推演： 2026 年年底，大概率就是这一轮熊市的终极底部； 2027 年市场会逐步企稳回暖； 真正的超级大牛市，会落在 2028 到 2029 年。

人这一生，没有多少个四年，更没有多少次让你从容抄底的超级熊市。

我从 2022 年入圈，短短几年，完整经历一轮牛熊，又站在了新一轮周期的起点。

这一次可能是我可以全力投入的最后一轮周期了。

说实话，我赶上了普通人很难遇到的行业周期末班车已经很幸运了。

行情越到底部，越要保持理性。

我已经重新开启了我的每日定投计划。

未来两个月，我将打出所有剩余的子弹。
author: yuexiaoyu
quoted_text:
《定投比特币指南：定投比特币是最简单却最有效的交易策略，但到底怎么定投呢？》

牛回速归，如今的牛市是比特币自己的牛市。

无论是VC币还是Meme币，都是零和博弈，甚至是负和博弈，赚钱的只是交易平台。

只有比特币才代表了整个行业的增量，当整个行业蛋糕变大时，持有比特币可以享受行业红利。

因此，定投比特币是最简单却最有效的交易策略，到底怎么定投比特币呢？

作为一个定投比特币的践行者，这里分享一些对定投的思考。

1.为什么定投策略可以生效？

定投策略之所以有效，主要基于以下三个关键因素：

（1）平均成本效应：通过定期投资，投资者可以在不同价格点购买资产，没有人预判最高点，也没有人能预判最低点，但是定投之后，你就可以买到两者之间的中间值，从而有效降低平均购买成本。

（2）市场周期特性：定投策略之所以有效，是因为这个策略符合现实世界的真实状况，即牛短熊长，熊市比牛市长，并且长很多很多。 通过定投策略，你的未来利润本质上全部来自于你所经历的熊市。

（3）长期增长潜力：比特币作为区块链行业的龙头标的，长期来看有持续增值的空间。跟着一个高速发展的行业走，你就能够吃到行业红利。这就是选择大于努力。

正如投资大师沃伦·巴菲特所倡导的价值投资理念，定投策略同样强调长期持有和耐心等待。

事实上，巴菲特一直在讲的价值投资，大多数情况下也并不是一次性购入的，他同样也会多次分批买入，而后长期持有。

同样定投策略采用者不过是在相当长一段时间内持续多次买入的同时坚决不卖，一直持有。

2.长期究竟是多久？

所谓长期，指的是两个大周期以上，穿越至少两次牛熊，即两次超过第一次的历史最高点。

在区块链行业，两个大周期大约是6到8年。

为什么会存在经济周期呢？

经济周期的形成，本质上是参与经济的多方协作时而协调、时而不协调造成的。

每一轮牛熊都是市场共识凝聚和崩塌的过程。

随着信息的高速流动，使得全球化协作更为连贯、更为容易，因此，虽然危机依然会不断产生，但是修复速度正在变得越来越快。

区块链数字资产交易市场的波动周期，总体上比股市的周期更短，并且将来会越来越短的核心原因在于，区块链交易市场的多方协调效率显然更高。

区块链交易市场全年24小时不间断交易，所以市场协调效率远远超出传统证券交易市场。

这也是为什么区块链行业的波动周期相对更短的主要原因。

3.怎么定投？

有人会对定投策略做各种改良，比如涨起来时就定投少一些、跌下去时就定投多一些。

但是，任何对定投策略的改良都是无效的。

一切与长期无关的细节都是鸡毛蒜皮。

定投很简单，长期地定时定量投入即可。

实施定投策略时，应遵循以下原则：

（1） 简单为上：定期定额投资是最简单有效的方法，不要过度复杂化策略。

（2）避免过度调整：试图根据市场短期波动来调整投资金额通常是徒劳的。

（3）保持一致性：无论市场涨跌，都应坚持既定的投资计划。

（4）长期视角：将注意力集中在长期目标上，忽略短期市场噪音。

4.怎么选择标的？

真正能够改变世界的大势实际上少之又少，若真的有下一个大势浮现，也应该是很多年以后而不是现在；而一个大势一旦被确认，它自身的发展以及它的影响发挥会持续很久很久。

其实，一生若是能够抓住一个大势，那已经是天大的幸运。

因此，选择大趋势的头部标的即可。

区块链技术是一个大趋势，而区块链行业的头部标的自然就是比特币。

要将资金集中在少数几个你最有信心的资产上，而不是分散到众多小众项目。

区块链行业发展太快了，不断有新热点、新叙事出现，但是比特币一直亘古不变，这才是行业的基石。

如果你真的想在Crypto行业长期玩下去，比特币的持仓一定不少于50%，也就是至少要占你全部资金的50%以上。

剩下的资金可以找一些自己认为可能长期改变行业格局的核心资产，看看能不能获得超额收益。

5.有没有什么数据指标可以指导定投呢？

经过时间的验证之后，目前还依旧有效的一个指标是：九神指数（也称为ahr999指数）。

ahr999 指数 = （比特币价格 /200 日定投成本） * （比特币价格 / 拟合预测价）

当ahr999指数 < 0.45 ，就可以抄底；

当ahr999在0.45-1.2之间，则适合定投；

当ahr999 >1.2，那么币价已经比较高了，不适合操作。

九神指数的核心思路主要是判断当前价格是否比过去一段时间的平均投资成本更有吸引力。

九神指数帮助投资者确定当前的价格在比特币价格历史上是否处于一个比较安全的投资区间，尤其是在进行定期投资（定投）时，具有一定指导意义。

但是任何量化模型都有其假设和局限性，九神指数也不例外。它基于历史数据和假设的增长模型，实际市场波动可能不完全符合这些模型预测。

因此，虽然九神指数提供了一个参考，但我们不能仅依据一个指标做出投资决策，还要考虑其他市场因素如宏观经济环境、技术分析、比特币网络的使用情况等等。

回归常识、回归初心、回归行业的核心价值。

定投策略的核心在于持续性和纪律性，我们要做时间的朋友。

text:
Neon xHigh  vs Opus 5.5 xHigh

我尝试了一下, 同样的两个任务:

1. 降低某交易机器人的 P90 延迟. 目标: 降低50%

2. 修复某交易机器人的bug. 要求 频率 * 严重程度 > 3   (意思就是太小的bug不要修)

让 GPT 6.2 xhigh 当评审来review.   

结论是 Opus 5.5 明显好很多. 结论质量更高.   Neon提出来的修复方案幻觉还是比较严重, 很多是review后发现站不住脚.

不过值得注意的是, Neon提出的一些方案是Opus 5.5没有想到的. (即使我开3个Opus 5.5 agent跑三次也想不到)  . 可以说明是模型训练集上的区别.

所以理想流程是:
Fable 5.2 High  做 coordinator , 然后 三个 subagent  Opus 5.5 xhigh + GPT 6.2 xhigh (Astra有点贵)  + Neon High

一起分析.   最后达成共识/ consensus.

不过比较麻烦的是 Antigravity 现在不允许自己的模型做其他模型的  subagent.  (据说 12月2日之后会有政策改变)

所以要么就是 
1.用Antigravity送的 credit 来跑 api.  这个可以做subagent

或者

2.在 Antigravity里, 用 Neon high 做 coordinator, 然后其他两家ai做 subagent.

下周主要的聚焦，也有软银和孙正义，因为周末市场传出孙正义曾探讨以 1 万亿美元收购 SK 海力士，但软银回应称已不再积极推进该交易，市场担心老哥还有更多的计划，正被叫停和终止。

在今年 6 月，孙正义高调认为 AI 这波可能比互联网泡沫大 50 倍，随后软银股价达到历史新高。

但等到 6 月底，市场传出他重仓押注的 OpenAI，可能把上市推迟到 2027 年，预计落后于 Anthropic 之后，原本押注该预期交易的投资者，纷纷撤退。

而到 7 月，他们旗下的 Arm 财报警告，内存涨价拖累手机版税，软银跟着探底。

8 月同时赶上，公司净利润大幅回撤，之后 9 月确定 OpenAI 本年度不再上市，致使软银再遭打击。

真正的连续下跌是 10、11 月开始，既有全球 AI 股抛售，也有软银自己的麻烦。在 11 月初，软银收购 ABB 机器人业务的中国部分被叫停，同一天马斯克突然称，软银正在违约，为数据中心建设投资的燃气轮机订单。

之后几天的财报显示，软银确实为数据中心发电设备计提了约 37 亿美元损失。WSJ 称，软银预订的燃气轮机远超实际需要，甚至取消了多余的部分。

结合这周末的不再积极考虑收购 SK 海力士交易传闻，孙正义的软银，似乎还有更多市场不知道的计划，正被叫停和终止。

现在的BSC始终无法打开上限

一个 7K 的盘，一晚上拉到 550k，顺手把两个百万市值的「蚂蚁」几乎吸血到腰斩。

起因只是 C总一句没点名的推文，加上校长一句私信回复。

这就是昨晚的 BSC 蚂蚁分流大战。原推和截图我都翻出来了，一步一步拆给你们看👇

【先看结局】（数据来自 AVE）
ANT（flap）：最高 238 万 → 现在 145 万
蚂蚁（four）：最高 114 万 → 一晚上腰斩，现在 75 万
OG 蚂蚁（flap）：7K → 55 万 → 现在 18 万，回撤 67%

【第一步：先埋一个「换车理由」】
21 号下午 6 点，有人发：蝴蝶的 ANT 在币安已经被 Anthropic 抢注了 ticker，Alpha 预期落空。
原推：https://t.co/aUctLbAlXs
这话到现在都没人证实，但种子已经埋下了。

同一天晚上 9 点，Flap 首日 1 万刀回购给了 ANT，C总转发说「蚂蚁赢了第一天🐜」。
https://t.co/GL78mgOJC8
注意，他这里说的「蚂蚁」，指的就是 ANT。

【第二步：一句没点名的话】
凌晨 2:06，C总发：「If a community is strong enough, vamp attacks only make it stronger. That's why I always bet on the OG that can withstand a vampire attack.」
https://t.co/YGDJGBUhUW
一个盘都没点名。但一分钟后，就有人开始刷「蚂蚁！蚂蚁！蚂蚁！」

【第三步：找一个能讲成 OG 的盘】
0x3 在频道里翻出 flap 上一个中文蚂蚁：18 号就创建了，ANTB 底池最早的那个，之前没人买过，7K 发出来。96、yyy、KeyNG 接力推。

【第四步：bug 变成背书】
50K 了还没打满，有人私信校长。校长回：「这个币是 og 了，ipo 时期创建的……所以 $72k 才会毕业」（截图见图 2）
2:32，KeyNG 连发三遍「蝴蝶出 BUG 了」，直接甩 CA

接着「校长亲口认证 OG」「全场唯一一个 72K 发射」满天飞。2:47 打满，早上 8 点最高 55 万。

【第五步：抽血】
OG 蚂蚁起来的那几个小时，four 的蚂蚁从 114 万掉到 57 万，ANT 从 180 万掉到 118 万。同一池子的钱，就这么被三个蚂蚁来回切。

有人当面问喊单的是不是先塞了 6% 左右再喊，对方回的是：KOL 就是要喊单，塞完看好时机出货。另一边也有人扒 ANT 前排的钱包，说 ANT 才是庄。两边站队，说到底都是为了自己手里的筹码。

【我怎么看】
这套路以后还会反复出现：
换车理由 → 大佬一句没点名的话 → 平台方一句回复 → 截图拼成「官方认证」→ KOL 接力 → 散户接盘

真正赚到钱的是 7K、几万就在里面的人。被「OG」「官方认证」「出 bug」这几个词吸引、30 万以上追进去的，基本都套着。

【关键点】
1. 大佬没点名的话，别替他翻译成喊单
2. 「官方认证」「OG」「出 bug」是故事，不是买点
3. 同题材后出来的盘，先查是谁发的、谁拿着低位筹码
4. 我只看真正有人维护、被回购的那一个，分流盘最多小仓位吃一口就走

说真的，BSC 现在的分流太严重了。一个好叙事本来可以合力做大，结果同名盘一个接一个出来抢流动性，你拉我砸、互相抽血，平台抢地盘，KOL 两头赚，最后接盘的永远是散户。再这样下去，链上只会越来越难做。

text:
有球友在雪球贴出一张小红书截图问段永平：网友称 Meta 的 AI 在“没给密码”的情况下自己登录了全部银行账号，会不会担心 AI 乱刷卡？

大道的回复直接戳破了盲点，还顺手分享了一个极其实用的风控习惯：“他怎么可以登入你的银行账号呢？你给密码了？我只给了个信用卡。”  

 1️⃣ 技术常识： 银行都有多重验证，AI 不可能凭空猜出密码。所谓“自己登录”，多半是用户在浏览器里保存了密码，又把桌面/浏览器控制权限全盘交给了 AI Agent；

2️⃣ 风控隔离： 体验 AI 代理功能时，千万别直接绑主力储蓄卡，像段永平这样只给一张独立信用卡（有额度上限 + 盗刷拒付保护），才是最稳妥的边界感。很多时候不是 AI 太危险，而是人类在点“允许所有权限”时太草率了。

author: pan_tokenpocket
quoted_text:
我说实话，腾讯小马哥最大失误是，还想玩不见兔子不撒鹰，等AI格局明朗直接提钱收购，结果想错了。腾讯基因是这么的，联众火了搞QQ游戏，泡泡堂火了搞QQ堂，跑跑卡丁车火了搞QQ飞车，一堆工具软件全被QQ版致敬挤死原创。直到3Q大战踢铁板，，此后不敢明抄改控股收购，从抄到买，核心还是后发制人：等别人验证模式，成功后，再用手上巨量流量和资金，完成收割。十五年躺赢，让腾讯养成了固定思维：别人能做的，我不用自己做；别人做出来的，我花钱就能买。于是，它放弃了搜索攻坚、放弃了电商死磕、放弃了短视频博弈、放弃了底层技术自研。遇到新赛道，第一反应从"我们怎么做"，变成了"我们投谁"。

可这招到AI上彻底失效。时间不等人啊，那时候的小马哥是咋说的？2023年股东大会上，马化腾谈AI时的关键词是“不着急”。“我们最开始以为这是互联网十年不遇的机会，但越想越觉得，这是几百年不遇的、类似发明电的工业革命一样的机遇。”他同时强调，不急于把半成品拿出来展示，“对于工业革命来讲，早一个月把电灯泡拿出来，在长的时间跨度上看不那么重要”，并批评一些公司“太急了，感觉是为了提振股价”。这套“等底层扎实、等应用拐点”的策略，直接决定了腾讯的起跑位置。2023年底混元大模型发布，晚于文心一言、通义千问和豆包；元宝App直到2024年年中才上线，且长期未投入资源推广。

QuestMobile数据显示，2025年初元宝月活仅275万，在AIGC应用中排名第九。马化腾在今年初的公司年会上对此有明确复盘，腾讯在AI上“动作慢了”，直到2024年底，元宝和混元才转入云与智慧产业事业群（CSIG），开始正式做产品。转折点来自DeepSeek。2025年初元宝率先接入DeepSeek-R1，一周内日均活跃用户增长10倍，随后配合大规模投流，下载量一度登顶苹果应用商店免费榜。但这条捷径同时暴露了自研的空心化。据财新报道，那一阶段不少用户打开元宝，为的是使用DeepSeek而非混元，自研模型在自己的产品里成了配角。这次借力也让腾讯看清了一件事，外部开源模型可以快速带来用户，却无法支撑模型与产品之间的协同迭代，自研能力终究绕不过去。二季度，腾讯资本开支飙升至528亿元，同比暴增176%，单季资本开支占收入比重达到25.8%，创下历史极值。更刺眼的是自由现金流，当季录得-138亿元，这是2005年以来腾讯单季自由现金流首次转负。

三年前马化腾说，早一个月拿出电灯泡并不重要；三年后，他的公司要求所有人“马上反馈，马上决策，马上行动”一来一去，还是让人唏嘘。外界总在讨论腾讯的增长瓶颈、业务危机、AI短板，这都是表象。腾讯真正的绝症，从来不是业务见顶、监管受限、竞争加剧，而是企业精神的彻底凋亡。它不再是一家探索未来、突破边界的科技公司，而是一家依托存量垄断资源，极致收割时代红利的商业食利者。

if you go over they bill you at a much higher rate. if you go below you're still paying for it. and the provider still sells the capacity to someone else anyway

it's so stupid, it's the opposite of why you use the cloud. they're supposed to be spreading supply across many customers and offer flexible pricing

this is was the whole breakthrough with AWS - they could charge you per minute for exactly what you used so you could scale up and down

inference needs to get there. it's difficult but that is the job. if you can't do it you should die

author: dr_orlovsky
quoted_text:
MIT published the most uncomfortable paper on vibe coding.

They tracked every new app that dropped on the app store, play store and chrome web store after coding agents showed up.

And the findings are brutal.

devs who started using autonomous agents wrote 25.5x more code. commits up 240%. repos touched up 80%. actual releases? +30%.

So like... where's the other 95% going?

In the trash.

After adopting tools claude code, devs wrote 7x more lines and deleted 12.2x more. repos abandoned within 30 days went from 60% to 69%.

and the storefront side is where it gets kinda bleak. new apps launching across the app store, play, chrome web store, sourceforge - roughly doubled since early 2025.

user engagement? didn’t move.

that's the part that messed with me honestly. twice as many apps shipping into the void. nobody downloading more, nobody using more. just... more noise on the shelf.

I’ve been thinking about this bc i felt it myself. i shipped three "projects" last month with claude code and im pretty sure zero humans used any of them.. its so easy to start something now that finishing stopped meaning anything.

writing code was never the real bottleneck. shipping something coherent, reviewing it properly, building a thing anyone wanted - that was.

author: rickawsb
quoted_text:
成立仅一个月、核心班底只有两个人的独立研究实验室 Generalised Superintelligence（GSI），最近因宣布在量子计算、超导物理、芯片设计和纯数学等八大领域取得 250 多项突破而刷屏。

重点是GSI不是模型公司，他们只不过做了个harness。

与主流大模型实验室依赖海量显卡“暴力穷举”不同，GSI 面对指数级爆炸的复杂科学难题，他们不让 AI 盲目试错，而是先让模型识别问题背后的代数与几何对称性，在五六分钟内现场编译出高度定制的专用求解器，直接砍掉绝大部分无效搜索空间。

这种思路让其在特定组合与逻辑问题上的求解速度比业界顶尖通用求解器快出数百甚至三万倍；更重要的是，团队刻意聚焦“寻找极难、验证极易”的形式科学，每一项产出都附带显式矩阵、不可满足性证明或可独立运行的代码证书，从根源上绕开了大模型的“幻觉”顽疾。

依托这套方法论，GSI 交出了一份涵盖多个硬核领域的成绩单。在纯数学领域，团队不仅在学界长期未解的阶数上构造出 200 多个高阶阿达玛矩阵（最高达 2148 阶），还严格证明了搜索空间高达 8.3 x 10^123 的经典循环差集难题无解。
在凝聚态物理领域，他们补全了困扰学界半个世纪的数学证明，将常规超导体最高转变温度经验公式中的核心比例常数精确锁定在 0.1827 这一物理天花板，并顺藤摸瓜审计出公开超导材料数据库中约 12.5% 的非物理错误数据。
此外，在量子计算与芯片设计（EDA）方向，GSI 分别将 IBM 著名的 Two-Gross 量子纠错码的抗噪底线精确锁定在 16 个量子比特，并为经典芯片布局基准算出了带有数学证书的“最短连线物理极限”。

GSI 的真正价值，在于展示了一种全新的 AI 科研范式：
将过去依赖启发式算法碰运气的工程摸索，推进到有明确理论上下界保底的精密科学。

更重要的是，GSI的成果证明了一点：当大模型能解决黎曼猜想，那么离解决高温超导、量子计算、芯片设计，可能就只差一个harness。

其实现在对于我们这种小资金来说，跌的越狠，对于我们越有利
甚至爆发金融危机更好，虽然这样想很不道德

2021年是我此生赚钱最多的时候，当时比特币一路狂飙，所有的垃圾资产都跟疯了一样...

但是这次我觉得没有那么好做

原因是两个月之后利空就都没有了，就是震荡向上，或者如果Ai不及预期，那就和美股一起震荡向下，我希望的是下一种情况，但我心里判断是第一种情况。

这些资产被打的越狠，普通人和顶尖人差距才能越小，穷人翻身的可能性就会越大！

但是沃什属于缩表降息派，并且很讨厌嘴，不会直接张口说类型。
市场就得疯狂猜，所以震荡会震的人发吐

先缩表： 央行把手里的长期国债和房贷债券慢慢减掉，市场上要接盘的长期债多了，长期利率反而可能往上走。
这块解释一下：
国债就是一张欠条：你花 100 块买下来，政府每年付你 4 块利息，到期还你 100 块。

这几年美联储是买国债最多的大户，手里囤了一大堆。
缩表就是这个大户不再接着买了：手里的债到期以后，他拿回钱，不再续买新的。
可政府还是要借钱，新发的债总得有人买。最大的买家走了，剩下的买家就少了。
买的人少，债就卖不上价。
债价跌了，利率就涨了。就是原本卖100的，现在90可以买到，但是拿到的4%变成了4.几%

这个对于资产是利空。

降息： 短期利率降了，钱变便宜。
政府还钱的成本也降低了！
这个对于全球资产都是好事儿！

所以，明年看的：
1 通胀数据不能增
2 正常降息，而不是迫于短期政治压力

这个人上台，对于大家，不太是一件好事只能说，太聪明了...
也太麻烦... 难算...

最喜欢简单暴力模式，全死，重新来...

text:
黄金十年，中国钱包鼓了，腰杆硬了。2012年，中国和菲律宾在黄岩岛对峙。美国调停，双方商定同时撤船。菲律宾当即撤船，但中国没撤。从此黄岩岛就归了中国控制。

美国和菲律宾说：哎你忽悠我。

傅莹外长认真解释：我们说的是撤出潟湖里的船，没说撤出整片海啊……

傅外长牛逼，给他们上了一堂博大精深的语言课。

此时美国说：“一旦钓鱼岛爆发战争，美国可依据《条约》介入战争维护日本”。此话一出，中美黄金十年，走向尽头。

但2014年11月，奥巴马到北京出席APEC会议，习近平还是把他请进了中南海。他说，“了解中国近代史，对理解中国人民今天的理想和道路很重要”。他还说：“戊戌变法失败，光绪皇帝被慈禧太后囚禁于此。”

当时老习正大力反腐，想昭告天下：朕不是光绪，不会当废帝。

奥巴马深情告白：“今晚，我这辈子最全面、深入了解到中国共产党的历史和执政理念以及您的思想”。情深深意浓浓，没回到黄金十年，但两国签了一系列合同。

按照中美虐恋规律，又该交恶了。

此时基建狂魔中国在南海疯狂造岛，在岛上布置导弹，驱离美机美舰。有一天解放军喊了8次美军都没反应，小战士急了，憋出一句牛逼的土味英语“油狗”……

美军就说“爱不狗，不狗，爱偏不狗”。小战士喊：油必须马上给我狗。

扯来扯去，菲律宾就把中国告上国际仲裁法庭。

海牙仲裁法院判中国败诉。

中国认定美国是“幕后操手”。两个月后，奥巴马出席杭州G20峰会。空军一号落地，原本得用美方自带的舷梯车，但中方临时改用中国舷梯车，又因翻译争执起来。奥巴马只好狼狈地从飞机机腹那道小门钻出来。

当年咸丰跑路，留守的奕訢签约时安排洋人走侧门，以示羞辱。可英法代表根本不在乎正门还是偏门，签约、提款、走人。

一百六十年过去了，大清还是大清。

三天后，奥巴马说：海牙仲裁裁决是“具有约束力”的。让美国总统走小门争了面子，却输了里子。奥巴马宣布中国输了仲裁官司，以后国际上就有依据了。

这也是深圳APEC会议，中美俄元首在《和平宣言》里，声明“国际仲裁法院不得滥用权力”的历史原因。

我的油管第16期：《中美合订本下集：黄仁勋事件加速中美冰河期到来》

2000年8月15日，江泽民用英文背颂林肯的葛底斯堡演说：“人人生而平等”……

华莱士突然问：显然，你们不相信中国人民能选出自己国家的领导。江泽民说：我也是选举出来的，只是我们的选举制度不一样。

2001年12月，美国帮助中国加入了世贸组织，中国从此进入风生水起、风车斗转的黄金十年。在胡锦涛任期，建立了全世界最完整的产业链，马云等一大批富豪涌现而出。

2012年底，习近平上台。美国这才发现：当初邓小平说“我们不怕美国的制度，美国也不必怕我们”，变成了“中国人民是惹不得的，如果惹翻了，是不好办的”。

那天，奥巴马出席杭州G20峰会。因为舷梯车，双方争执起来。奥巴马只好狼狈地从飞机的小门钻出来。当年咸丰带着慈禧跑路，让鬼子六跟洋人谈判。为了找面子，奕訢签约时安排洋人走侧门，以示羞辱。可英法代表不在乎走正门还是偏门，签完条约，提款走人。

这次的深圳APEC会议，高市早苗上演相同情景。

2017年11月，习近平夫妇陪同川普夫妇参观故宫，在紫禁城宝蕴楼喝茶。修建这宝蕴楼的钱，正是出自美国退还的庚子赔款。

中美签了创纪录的大单子，可很多没兑现。川普翻脸了。2018年3月22日，川普宣布关税战，正式开打。

1765年3月22日，英国议会通过《印花税法》向北美殖民地加税。北美人民喊出“无代表，不纳税”。这是独立战争的导火索。而1916年3月22日，袁世凯被迫宣布撤销帝制，从此天下纷纷，这一天，是中国命运的一道分水岭。

习近平修宪成功一年后，江山已定，说出了那句“中美合则两利、斗则俱伤”。2月14日，情人节，中美同时把关税减半，算是给对方献上了礼物。

所有的虐恋都充满反转。2020年1月23日，武汉封城。两国互相报复。北京关闭美国驻成都总领馆。闭馆那天，群众放鞭炮、高举国旗、喊“中国共产党万岁”。

2021年9月，孟晚舟乘包机回到深圳，天天操心房贷车贷的爱国群众高唱《歌唱祖国》，迎接一位拿着枫叶卡的富豪回家。孟晚舟说：“如果信念有颜色，那一定是中国红”。

中国最好演员从来都不在中戏。

《中国的权贵资本主义》的作者裴敏欣下过一句定论：“中美关系表现出典型的躁郁症症状，在狂喜和抑郁之间剧烈摇摆”。

美丽的斐洛里庄园，拜登提醒习近平：过几天是彭丽媛的生日，祝她生日快乐。拜登翻出一张老照片：31岁的习近平站在金门大桥……套近乎，忆童年，拿照片，起音乐，拜登一定看过朱军的艺术人生。

2025年1月——川普再次回来。双方反复开战、停火……直到9月23日习近平回访美利坚，21响礼炮，红地毯，枪操阵，国宴和音乐剧。你浓我侬，猫盖屎把贸易战延期。

元首的身体到底怎么样？

1953年3月1日晚上10点，当卫兵冲进房，发现伟大的斯大林同志躺在地板上，裤子都尿湿了，身旁有一份《真理报》。

我们的历史每天都很正确，就是不方便看合订本。深圳APEC会议。爱国网友盛赞这是雅尔塔会议——但雅尔塔会议上，斯大林强行让外蒙从中国独立出去，中国版图从秋海棠变成公鸡状。

1985年，兰蒂女士策划了中国河北农业考察团来到美国小城马斯卡廷。这一天，一个年轻的县委书记来了，由于旅馆满了，兰蒂只好安排他住进当地一个居民家。经费有限，大家就办了一场各家带菜的百家饭，又借来一条密西西比河上的游船，在上边烤猪肉。

这个中国年轻人，就是习近平。

习近平对卧室墙上的“星际迷航”很感兴趣。房东说：他守时、能干、好奇。他还对兰蒂那辆红色敞蓬跑车很感兴趣，提出试驾……可兰蒂拒绝了。

习近平每天去工厂、农村参观学习，他说是来“学习怎么养活人民”的。他还说喜欢马克·吐温作品。贝罗内陪同习近平去到一处农场，马克·吐温曾将手稿藏在农场的一面墙里。那两周大家过得非常愉快，五六个男人一起公路旅行，就像一部公路电影。

温情不会永远继续，兰蒂写了一本《老朋友：习近平与爱荷华的故事》。书一路遭受中方审稿，最终中文版被取消。

一个中国商人曾买下习近平住过的房子，改名“中美友谊屋”。可因为疫情和两国交恶，露台掉漆，地基发霉，百叶窗褪色。当年的房东说：“这栋房子就是中美关系的象征……”

兰德坐在接待过习近平的客厅里说：“这次习近平回来，好像变了一个人，他不像邓小平，更像毛泽东，这很糟糕……”

中美回不去“黄金十年”了，随着黄仁勋事件、强硬派上任，骨子里价值观差异，思想上的生殖隔离，一场冰河期加速袭来。

text: 🇯🇵 BREAKING: A report presented to Japan's Ministry of Finance names Canton Network to test tokenized government bonds in Japan's $1.56 trillion repo market. https://t.co/YEKOju7nvd
author: chainyoda
quoted_text:
🇯🇵 DOCUMENT FOUND: A 59-page report presented to Japan's Ministry of Finance on November 20 names Canton Network as the testing infrastructure for Japan's $1.56 trillion government bond repo market.

Prepared by the Progmat-led Digital Asset Co-Creation Consortium (DCC), it covers tokenized Japanese government bonds, deposits, stablecoins and collateral management.

Key findings:

1. Canton Network selected for testing
The consortium plans a sandbox on Canton Network Testnet to issue and manage tokenized JGBs, deposits and stablecoins, connecting domestic and international repo and collateral platforms.

2. The ¥250 trillion-plus JGB repo market is the focus
About 40% of trades clear outside a central counterparty. The proposed setup would support:
• 24/7 settlement across international markets
• Atomic settlement of securities and digital cash
• Intraday financing with JGBs as collateral
• Automated repo and collateral management

3. Existing JGBs could move on-chain without changing their legal status
Instead of creating separate claims, existing book-entry bonds would connect to blockchain accounts, keeping legal ownership intact.

4. Bank of Japan integration is under consideration
The report examines API links to the BOJ's bond settlement system. This is a proposal, not confirmation that the BOJ has adopted Canton.

5. Technical verification runs through March 2027
The next phase tests interoperability, settlement, collateral management and operations. Commercial deployment is not yet confirmed.

Source: Japan Ministry of Finance, Nov 20, 2026. Progmat / DCC, Tokenized Government Bonds and On-Chain Repo Working Group, Interim Report (October 2026).

author: IamRamenPanda
quoted_text:
客观来说，当前的情况已经很坏了，还可以更坏吗？

更坏就是复刻2000的互联网泡沫。

当时的互联网泡沫里的基建泡沫大概是这样的：

需求端：VC投资的各种互联网初创公司，永远缺服务器缺光纤，重复给运营商下单，当VC不愿意投钱后，需求见顶，股价下跌，然后VC更不愿意投钱，直接死循环。

供给端：运营商以为需求很多，也在疯狂基建，结果有重复下单，需求端直接没了，运营商也开始砍单。泡沫破裂。

再看现在：

需求端：当期我们没有看到需求下降。这次AI的需求分两个方面，一个是B端、C端用AI的群体，另一边是AI模型公司和云厂商。

对于B端和C端用户，大家会不会因为股价下跌就不用AI，大概率不会；

云厂商是否会因为股价下跌，就暂停资本开支（有可能，因为股价下跌后股权融资的通道就基本关闭了，如果跌太多管理层会有压力，虽然过去几年亚马逊、谷歌的管理层没吃压力。新云的股权融资通道也基本关闭。）

供给端：晶圆厂、光模块、存储都在扩产，扩产落地大概在2027年底和2028年，从扩产惯性上来看晶圆厂最难掉头、其次是存储、最后是光模块。已经开始扩产的可能还得继续建，但在计划中的可能会停止。所以大概率情况是扩产继续，但速度比几个月前想的会慢一些？具体还得看四季度财报。

整体上来看，基本面上当前和一个月前其实没太大区别，唯一变了的就是股价，而股价下跌是否会导致需求端和供给端的变化，我觉得也挺不确定的。但市场习惯于线性外推。

“他用Blackwell创造了奇迹……我们绝不想让中国或任何人拿到Blackwell。”

“我们在芯片制造上实际上领先中国10年，这是黄仁勋做到的。”

“英伟达公司里能做成这件事的人极少极少。”

“如果董事会聪明的话，他们应该接受这个聪明人的道歉，让他回去工作。”

特朗普已经第三次，公开喊话支持黄仁勋回归英伟达了。

特朗普没在开玩笑。他把黄仁勋直接定性为“美国领先中国10年的核心技术资产”。

这等于把董事会再次架在火上烤——你们不让老黄回来，就是在拿美国的国家科技壁垒开玩笑。

但他的这番话，有一半是废话。

董事会当初赶人，用的是什么借口？私德、缺乏坦诚。
现在特朗普说“道个歉就能回去”，董事会能答应吗？

赶人容易，请人难。一句道歉，翻不过资本博弈的那页，这是明摆着跟民主党那帮人对着干！

黄仁勋被赶下台，背后就是共和党部分反特朗普的政客、民主党和Anthropic创始人和美国媒体联合组的局！

所以，短期看，黄仁勋是很大概率回不去英伟达的。

权力的椅子一旦交出去，现任管理层绝不可能低头把创始人请回来。

但长期看，英伟达会被现实逼着把他请回来。

如果股价继续大跌，核心工程师继续提离职，AI次贷的雷继续爆，董事会就会明白：
跟公司的生死存亡比，面子一文不值。

那么，这次特朗普的话管用吗？

总统的政治施压是引信，最终炸开的，是英伟达内部的生死危机。

只要业绩和股价还在流血，黄仁勋的班师回朝，就只是时间问题。

现在就看英伟达股票价格跌得多狠，核心工程师们离职跳槽有多大了。

黄仁勋此时此刻，是否在观看特朗普的电视讲话呢？
他是否也希望英伟达股票跌至100美金以下呢？

text:
刚在和 @lxfater 聊天，我们有个共同的痛点就是开拍前的布景和打光问题。想到我的清单里有一个我一直想做的创业项目，只是偏线下比较重，我一直没有开始。今天我来分享出来。

这个问题面向的目标用户，是像我一样在大城市做自媒体、或者想做自媒体的人。

他们每次拍摄前，想要一个合理的背景、景深和布光其实相当麻烦。而且大城市租金比较贵，很多人很难在自己的小出租屋里面，有专门的空间来做这件事，这是一件很奢侈的事。

我想做的模式，是类似于共享自习室：

1. 按小时收费，在小程序预约，大概一个小时 100 到 200 元这个区间。
2. 给用户提供对应的灯光、三脚架，麦克风等拍摄器材（甚至包括相机和镜头），包括背景之类的。
3. 通过可移动的道具和打灯进行变化，其实能很快为每个人布置出不同风格的场景。

我一直很期待有这样的东西。但我目前搜了一下，现有的模式大部分都是共享直播间，而且很多是日租的形式，不像共享自习室、也不像我说的这种模式这么高效。

我觉得这种模式是可以在一线城市铺开的。虽然没有认真去测算这部分目标用户的客群规模，但我拍脑袋想是能跑通的。

在我看来，一天只要有 1 到 2 个可用时段被人出租，基本上这个模式就不会亏本。

甚至还可以提供像比较简单的底粉底液底妆自助服务，或者提供相关的线上剪辑师初剪 +培训服务。我觉得可以同时通过这个工作室，创造出一些相关的就业机会。

I believe the latest developments around $CLAUDIA are more significant than previous Elon interactions.

2j5SaS7xy776qCBpyPQbZjyQSAtKiFgrwjfErthnW2ZM 

Previously, the market was mainly betting on whether Elon would notice Claudia again.

This time, however, the market is beginning to see that Claudia herself is developing stronger content production capabilities, creator participation, and potential commercial applications.

I believe this is the main reason why the market cap was able to break above the ceiling of previous rallies and reach approximately $12M, rather than producing another brief doubling move as before.

However, we need to separate the different factors behind this rally. Elon's direct interaction was the immediate catalyst, Michael Saylor brought additional attention from outside the usual crypto and AI creator circles, while Anabology's recent product and content updates provide the foundation for the market to reassess Claudia's longer-term potential.

In other words, celebrity interactions have now taken Claudia's exposure to a different level.

Let's start with Elon.

Anabology recently showcased a Claudia music video created using Gemini 4 Neon. He mentioned that the initial results were not particularly good, but after spending several days experimenting and refining the output, he eventually produced the current version. Elon then replied directly to the post with just two words: "Not bad."

There is an important detail here: Elon was responding to an actual AI-generated creative work, rather than promotional material about the project.

This means Claudia has once again entered Elon's attention through the content itself. For an AI-native IP, getting a well-known external figure to respond to an actual creative work is more meaningful than simply receiving an interaction on a promotional post introducing the project.

Now let's look at Michael Saylor.

His post was captioned "Every day we Stretch. STRC," and the video featured Claudia's recognizable appearance: black hair, an orange highlight, and her signature star hair clip.

One distinction is important here: Saylor did not explicitly mention CLAUDIA, express support for the token, or indicate any formal partnership. However, Claudia's visual identity appeared in content associated with Strategy and Bitcoin-related financial products. At the very least, this gives her exposure to an audience and content environment that traditionally has little connection to AI music creators.

I find these two events more interesting when viewed together rather than simply counting how many times Elon has interacted with Claudia. One involves direct recognition of Claudia's creative output, while the other shows her recognizable visual identity appearing in a broader financial and crypto-related context.

The signal the market is receiving is no longer just whether Claudia can attract attention again, but whether this character can appear across increasingly diverse content environments.

Another development I am particularly interested in is the recent Gemini 4 Neon experiment.

Anabology was not simply publishing another generated video. He was using the process to benchmark different models. He showed the differences between the initial and refined versions, explaining that the original animation was more creative, but parallax errors damaged the immersion, so he asked the model to refine it. He also mentioned that Fable 5.2 remains a high-quality benchmark in his view, while Neon has some promising capabilities in multi-image editing and maintaining Claudia's facial consistency.

This reinforces a direction we have discussed before, but which is becoming increasingly clear: Anabology is building a content production workflow around a consistent character.

He no longer needs to create an entirely new character from scratch every time. Instead, he can combine the strengths of different models to continuously produce music, videos, and visual content featuring Claudia.

The real value here is not Gemini 4 Neon or Fable 5.2 themselves. The relative strengths of different models will continue to change, and new tools will keep emerging. But Claudia already has recognizable visual characteristics and an established content history. Anabology's task is to use increasingly capable models to bring this character into new content environments.

Another update worth noting is Anabology's attempt to bring Claudia into advertising.

He released a cookie delivery advertisement featuring Claudia and said the result turned out better than much of his usual content.

This does not prove that the project has secured commercial advertising contracts, but it shows that Claudia does not have to be limited to music videos anymore. Advertising, product demonstrations, and short-form marketing content could all become new use cases.

For an AI virtual artist, the ability to participate in commercial creative work means that her potential value does not have to depend entirely on views and celebrity interactions.

The creator ecosystem is also moving beyond competitions toward broader participation.

On November 19, Anabology announced another Claudia design contest. This time, the competition was no longer limited to music videos. It offers $250 in XMoney to the creator of the best 15–30-second video featuring Claudia in any way they choose, with submissions due by Thanksgiving.

At first glance, this may look like just another community contest. However, when viewed alongside the previous music video competitions, the team's intention becomes clearer: continuously lowering the barriers for external creators to participate in Claudia's content production.

The earlier music video competitions already allowed external creators to use Claudia MCP to produce content and compete for judging and community-voted rewards. Now, the project is expanding into design and short-form videos. This means participants do not necessarily need music production skills. They can enter the ecosystem through visual creativity, advertising concepts, and other video formats.

I believe this is more important than simply increasing the number of followers on Claudia's social accounts. If an AI character relies entirely on official content production, its reach will eventually be limited by the team's capacity. But if different creators can use Claudia to produce whatever they want, the content supply has an opportunity to expand considerably.

Of course, I would not say that a mature creator ecosystem has already been established. Competition prizes can attract participation, but they do not guarantee that creators will continue producing content after the events end. What matters is whether these works can spread independently of the competitions and whether some creators begin treating Claudia as a character they want to build around over the long term.

There is another interesting detail.

Anabology recently quoted Justin Coope's comments about Claudia. He described her as becoming the first Idoru and specifically mentioned the "Little Red Riding Hood" song, saying it had been stuck in his head for an entire week.

I think this feedback is quite valuable.

People are beginning to remember not just Claudia's appearance, but also specific pieces of music associated with her. This suggests that the character is starting to develop musical recognition. Visual consistency helps people recognize Claudia, but what ultimately allows a virtual artist to build a lasting audience is having works that people remember, replay, and actively share.

This is also why I am increasingly willing to include the Idoru positioning in Claudia's long-term thesis. She may be evolving beyond an AI-generated character into a virtual artist with a consistent identity, an expanding body of work, and an audience that recognizes her.

There is another question everyone seems curious about: why was this rally able to reach a $12M market cap when previous rallies mostly produced moves of around 1x?

I think the key is not that Elon suddenly became more supportive of Claudia than before. It is that the market is now seeing several different potential growth opportunities at the same time.

Previously, the rallies were primarily driven by Elon's content interactions. Each interaction brought another wave of external exposure, but the market always had one major question: if Elon stopped interacting, what else could attract attention to CLAUDIA?

This time, there are some new answers.

Elon's direct response to the creative work reinforces the possibility of recurring celebrity attention. Saylor's video provides exposure to a different audience. Anabology's ongoing model experiments demonstrate that content production capabilities are still improving. The design competition continues to bring in external creators, while the advertising experiment makes the commercial use case more tangible.

These are not simply unrelated announcements. They are beginning to form a connected growth cycle:

Improving creative tools → Continuous Claudia content production → External creator participation → Amplification by celebrities and other platforms → More people discovering the character → New content and commercial use cases.

I believe this is the most important development behind the current revaluation.

Previously, buyers were largely betting on whether Elon would repost Claudia again. Now, some investors may be pricing in a much larger possibility: whether Claudia can become a virtual artist in AI-native entertainment with a continuous supply of content.

This creates more reasons for attention to persist beyond a single celebrity interaction.

Compared with our previous analysis, I believe at least four of our earlier views have received further support.

First, Elon's attention is becoming a repeatable catalyst. We previously observed multiple interactions between him and Claudia-related content. His latest response to Anabology's work shows that this external attention has not disappeared after the previous rallies.

Second, Claudia is beginning to evolve from an individual creator's project into an open IP. One of the biggest questions we previously had was whether Anabology could move beyond producing everything himself. Now, external creators are participating in competitions, using Claudia MCP to create content, and even having their works amplified directly by Elon. This is a very meaningful development.

Third, the sustainability of AI-native content production is receiving further support. The Gemini 4 Neon experiments, comparisons between different models, continuous video refinements, and advertising experiments all show that Anabology is not simply repeating the original AI music video format. He is continuously expanding Claudia's content boundaries.

Fourth, Claudia's commercial use cases are beginning to take shape. Her previous signing with GLIF and the opening of its Casting platform already introduced Claudia into an AI modeling agency's distribution network. Now, there is also an advertising creation example. Although actual commercial orders and revenue have not yet been demonstrated, the direction is becoming more concrete.

However, three important questions remain unanswered:

Can external creators continue producing Claudia content without financial incentives from competitions?

Can advertising and platforms like GLIF generate actual commercial orders and a stable external audience?

Can Claudia's IP growth eventually translate into real, verifiable demand for CLAUDIA through mechanisms such as using trading fees to fund content production?

The final point is particularly important. The current competition rewards are paid through XMoney, and the advertising experiments have not disclosed any specific revenue-sharing arrangements. Growth in IP influence does not automatically translate into value for the token.

Looking ahead, I will be watching four developments closely.

First, the results of the latest $250 design competition. I want to see whether high-quality submissions emerge, whether external creators continue participating, and whether their work can spread independently after the competition ends.

Second, Claudia's commercial content. If advertising gradually evolves from Anabology's own experiments into a situation where other brands and creators actively use Claudia, the project's potential market could expand considerably.

Third, more celebrity interactions and exposure across external platforms. Elon has repeatedly demonstrated that Claudia-related content can enter his attention, while Saylor's post provides exposure to a different audience. What matters next is whether this distribution expands to more independent creators, music communities, and AI content platforms, rather than simply repeating interactions with the same group of celebrities.

Finally, token value capture. If we eventually see trading fees consistently allocated to content production, those investments generating new works, and those works attracting new users and trading demand, then CLAUDIA may have an opportunity to establish a more complete economic cycle.

My final assessment, based on the developments above, is that CLAUDIA's fundamentals have strengthened noticeably.

What I care about most now is not whether Elon will repost Claudia again, but whether Claudia can gradually become an AI virtual artist whom people are willing to create for, watch, and use even without Elon's involvement.

If that happens, the ceiling for CLAUDIA will no longer be limited to a Meme that depends on celebrity interactions. It could become an AI-native IP with continuous content production, an independent creator network, and commercial distribution channels.

That is why I believe CLAUDIA is still worth researching after breaking above the levels reached in its previous rallies.

Elon two recent interactions further validate one of our core theses about $CLAUDIA: his attention is gradually shifting from occasional content interactions into a repeatable external attention catalyst.

2j5SaS7xy776qCBpyPQbZjyQSAtKiFgrwjfErthnW2ZM 

More importantly, he is now amplifying content that goes beyond Anabology’s own creations.

There are two details worth examining.

First: Elon reposted Ted’s post about AI Influencers.

The original post made the prediction that more than 50% of the content people watch over the next two years could come from AI Influencers. It also introduced Claudia as an example, mentioning her connection with Anabology and Glif.

Elon added the following comment: “Super intelligence will hack your limbic system.”

The significance of this interaction is not simply that Claudia received more exposure. It is that she is now being placed within a much broader AI Influencer narrative. The market has an opportunity to start viewing Claudia as a new type of AI entertainment character, rather than just an AI music video project.

Second: On November 17, Elon reposted the winning entry from Anabology’s creator competition, with just two words: “I remember.”

What makes this interaction particularly interesting is the origin of the content. The video was not independently produced by Anabology. It was an entry created by an external creator through Claudia’s creative ecosystem.

Looking at both interactions together, we can see two different distribution channels emerging. In the first, a third-party account places Claudia within the broader AI Influencer narrative. In the second, a community creator produces content around Claudia, which is then amplified by Elon.

This directly supports one of the directions we have been most interested in: Claudia is beginning to demonstrate the potential to move beyond Anabology’s original content channels and enter a broader distribution network involving independent creators and external platforms.

What is the market betting on now?

I think there are three layers to it.

First, short-term capital may increasingly be betting on Elon interacting with Claudia again.

His repeated attention to Claudia-related content over the past period has already created a certain market expectation. Two reposts within a short period will only strengthen traders’ anticipation of another round of exposure. For a Meme token, this is a straightforward attention-driven trading narrative. However, that does not mean every buyer is necessarily betting on Elon’s next repost.

Second, the market may be pricing in Claudia’s potential to become an AI Influencer.

The first post placed Claudia within the broader AI Influencer trend, while the second demonstrated that the creator competition can generate new content from outside the original team. Combined with GLIF’s official signing of Claudia, the opening of its Casting feature, and the continued development of MCP-based creative tools, the project is gradually trying to connect content production, creator participation, and commercial distribution.

Third, and what I consider the most valuable long-term direction, is whether Claudia can develop into an AI-native IP with an independent creator ecosystem.

If more people begin voluntarily creating music, videos, and derivative content around Claudia, she will no longer be just a virtual character managed by Anabology. Instead, she could become an IP expanded by multiple independent creators. If this happens, her external exposure will no longer depend entirely on Elon.

At the same time, I think there is a new development worth being cautious about. As Elon’s repeated interactions become an established market expectation, traders may start positioning themselves in advance for the possibility of his next interaction.

This could make CLAUDIA’s short-term price increasingly dependent on external attention. If Elon temporarily stops reposting, or subsequent content fails to achieve similar reach, short-term capital could quickly exit.

My current assessment is that these two interactions have further strengthened CLAUDIA’s narrative fundamentals, but they have not yet demonstrated a corresponding improvement in the token’s underlying economic value.

What I most want to observe next is whether Claudia can continue receiving content from different creators, and whether that content can gain traction even without Elon’s involvement.

If that happens, Elon will no longer be Claudia’s only important source of attention. He will simply be the most influential distribution channel among many.

That is the development I find most promising about CLAUDIA: initially, the market was betting on whether Elon would notice her again. Now, the more important question is whether, as more people become familiar with Claudia, they will start creating new content around her voluntarily.

何一今天凌晨说：SBF 打电话向 CZ 求救时，讲的是「只有流动性问题」；事后法院披露，缺口超过 80 亿美元。

这两句话差在哪，SBF 自己做过一张表。

2022 年 11 月 7 日，挤兑最凶的那天，他的表上客户的钱约 120 亿美元，一周内能凑出来的现金 39 亿。中间差的 80 亿，后来成了庭审上被反复提到的那个数。

「流动性问题」的意思是钱还在，只是一时取不出来。SBF 到现在还这么说，他常拿来举的是后来的赔付：清算团队把 Alameda 和 FTX Ventures 投出去的股权一点点卖掉，包括昨天视频里聊的那批 Anthropic 股份，大多数客户按破产那天的价格拿回了 119%。

可这 119% 是按美元记的。破产那天一枚 BTC 记不到 1.7 万美元，今天差不多 6 万。当年在 FTX 放了一枚 BTC 的人，拿回的钱现在只够买三分之一枚左右。

钱后来补上了，和钱当时就在，是两回事。2023 年陪审团认定他挪用了客户资金，今年 6 月二审维持定罪。

listening to men like elon, ilya, or sam, you can sense a twinge of relief, that the utter absurdity and terrible magnificence that have been driving them near crazy their entire lives is slowly becoming universal, that the sheer derealization (which drives one to believe their life is too odd to not be some strange prank or simulation) that comes naturally with being the one monkey in eight billion, no, a hundred and seventeen billion (to ever live), strapped to the launch chair at the end of the world, is infecting the rest of us: a strangeness that has been building since maybe the dawn of agriculture, or fire, and finally coming to an unignorable global front. welcome to the technological singularity.

Terrence McKenna: “It’s only going to get weirder. The level of contradiction is going to rise excruciatingly, even beyond the excruciating present levels of contradiction. So I think it’s just going to get weirder and weirder and weirder. And finally, it’s going to be so weird that people are going to have to talk about how weird it is. And at that point, novelty theory can come out of the woods. Because eventually people are going to say, “What the hell is going on?” It’s just too nuts! It’s not enough to say it’s nuts, you have to explain why it’s so nuts.

So between now and 2012, the next fourteen years, I look for the invention of artificial life, the cloning of human beings, possible contact with extraterrestrials, possible human immortality, and at the same time, appalling acts of brutality, genocide, race-baiting, homophobia, famine, starvation—because the systems which are in place to keep the world sane are utterly inadequate to the forces that have been unleashed. The collapse of the socialist world, the rise of the Internet—these are changes so immense, nobody could imagine them ever happening. And now that they have happened, nobody even bothers to mention what a big deal it is. The fact that there is no such thing as the Soviet Union—people never talk about it anymore. But when I was a kid, the notion that that would ever change was beyond conceiving….

The mushroom said to me once, it said, “This is what it’s like when a species prepares to depart for the stars.” You don’t depart for the stars under calm and orderly conditions. It’s a fire in a madhouse. And that’s what we have: the fire in the madhouse at the end of time. This is what it’s like when a species prepares to move on to the next dimension. The entire destiny of all life on the planet is tied up in this. We are not acting for ourselves or from ourselves. We happen to be the point species on a transformation that will affect every living organism on this planet at its conclusion.”

Anvil is coming .

In the myth, Hephaestus forged every machine on his anvil. For HEPH, Anvil is where operators take control of theirs.

Over the past weeks, we shipped the foundation of the machine economy on Robinhood Chain Mainnet. Every piece is live and verifiable.

WHAT WE HAVE FORGED

1. Machine Passports
Every machine gets an onchain identity, an owner, spending limits and a kill switch. Three reference devices are live.
https://t.co/uIrgpI6NJR

2. Machine Pay
A robot paid a charger 0.80 USDG over HTTP 402, with 0 ETH and gas sponsored in USDG. Over-limit, frozen and replayed payments were all blocked.
https://t.co/LmKdRNVG0x

3. Omnichain Passports
Passports registered on Robinhood Chain are now verifiable on Arbitrum One through LayerZero V2 messaging, secured by two required DVNs.
https://t.co/NAPOLskSOj

WHAT ANVIL BRINGS

The contracts already enforce identity, limits and freezes. Anvil puts that power in the operator's hands, without a single line of code.

→ Fleet overview: every robot, drone and charger in one screen, with balances, daily spend and status
→ Spend policy control: update daily and per-transaction caps from a form, signed by your own wallet
→ Kill switch: freeze one machine or the entire fleet in one action
→ Activity log: every payment, blocked payment, policy change, freeze and sweep, each linked to its transaction
→ Alerts: notifications before a machine hits its limit or runs low on funds
→ Reports: export every transaction for accounting
→ Safe support: multisig operators can propose actions directly to their Safe

BUILT ON ONE PRINCIPLE

HEPH never holds operator keys. Every action in Anvil is signed by the operator and executed onchain. The dashboard reads; the operator decides.

Here's how we upgraded Machine Passports to omnichain.

A machine registered on Robinhood Chain can now be verified on Arbitrum One.
Built on LayerZero V2 messaging.

HOW IT WORKS

→ Passports live on Robinhood Chain (source of truth)
→ Every change is broadcast to Arbitrum One as a read-only mirror
→ Any contract on Arbitrum can call isActive(machineId) before trusting a HEPH machine
→ Freeze on Robinhood Chain, frozen on Arbitrum seconds later
→ Money, limits and pools never leave Robinhood Chain

TESTED LIVE ON MAINNET

✅ O1 · Initial sync: HEPH-REF-001 active on Arbitrum One
✅ O2 · Kill switch: freeze propagated cross-chain
✅ O3 · Unfreeze: version counter moved v1 → v2
✅ O4 · Anti-replay: stale payloads rejected
✅ O5 · Anti-rogue: messages from unknown senders rejected
✅ O6 · Keeper offline: anyone can call sync(), no single point of failure

6 scenarios. 6 passes.

SECURITY BY DESIGN

→ 2-of-2 required DVNs: LayerZero Labs + Horizen Labs
→ Versioned payloads: old messages can never overwrite new ones
→ Fail-closed: a passport not synced for 24 hours is automatically deactivated on the mirror

text:
A toothpaste company showed you can run market research with AI. Here's their method as a prompt.

Colgate and PyMC Labs tested AI "customers" against 57 real product surveys and 9,300 human answers. They got to 90% of human test-retest reliability.

The trick: never ask the AI for a 1 to 5 score. It gives safe, middle answers. Ask it to talk, then score what it said.

Step 1, run 30 to 50 times per customer type:
"You are a [age] year old [gender] earning [income] in [city]. You usually buy [category] at [store]. Here is a new product: [concept and price]. In 3 to 5 sentences, say honestly what you think and whether you'd buy it. Don't give a number."

Step 2, paste all the answers into a new chat:
"Score each answer from 1 to 5, where 1 = 'I would never buy this' and 5 = 'I'd buy this today.' Give me the average per customer type and the top 3 objections."

The paper scores answers with embeddings. This is the no-code version.

text:
Some random, unfiltered thoughts on AI and the market:

The gulf between “San Francisco” and “New York” has never been wider than it is right now 

AI is accelerating in capability, rapidly and in a way that is structurally changing, and in many ways upending, the nature of the firm and the fundamentals of capitalism

If that sounds extreme, consider that Anthropic has ~6,000 employees, Meta has 67,000, and both companies are worth ~$1.5T

Talk to your average startup and it’s clear that, given the opportunity to start from scratch, nobody is building their companies “the old way.” 

Talk to your average Fortune 500 company and it’s clear that getting an AI agent into production at scale is a Herculean task

Intelligence may not be the bottleneck, but firms built from the foundational assumption that intelligence is improving quickly in capability and price are scaling at a genuinely unbelievably velocity

There’s a reason Zuck wanted to fire 60% of many of the teams at his company, in large part likely out of frustration that he can’t start from scratch like his competitors had the luxury of doing

A structurally weaker Nvidia and OpenAI have minimal impact on the pace and impact of AI diffusing across the economy (“San Francisco”), but completely breaks the models built in “New York.” Hence the absolute freak-out these last few weeks. It was all priced to go perfectly and now things are not perfect 

But for the boots on the ground, AI will not slow down. And counterintuitively, economic weakness might accelerate diffusion. After all, tokens are much more fungible and flexible than people

Where does that leave us? I think firmly in the second phase of the AI build-out. Real value is being built in the app layer (though how defensible it is…TBD).  

Trying to predict the next bottleneck, or whether Washington does this or that other thing wrt policy, or exactly how many data centers get built out…who can say? Certainly not me. It’s not the bet I’m trying to make 

I’m looking at who wins from rapidly improving intelligence available at increasingly cheaper prices, and critically, which leaders are able to move with conviction into this new operating paradigm

Suno AI has a new video creation tool for the music you make, and it is actually incredible.

You can connect it to Grok Bot via MCP and direct the entire song and video.

Setup:

1. Grab the MCP server address from Suno's help page.

2. In Grok Bot, tell it to add a custom MCP server called Suno at that address.

3. The Bot repeats the name and address back. Check it, then hit Add it.

4. A connect card appears in the chat. Authorize, sign in to Suno, approve access.

5. Type @, attach Suno, and start directing.

text:
📌刚看了一篇 Anthropic 早期投资人的三年投资复盘，蛮有意思的——

作者是一个 2023 年进入家族办公室投资团队的年轻投资人，从Anthropic 约 50 亿美元估值开始研究，到亲眼见证一家万亿美元级别公司的诞生。

比起投资回报，文章里更让我感兴趣的是，这三年里作者对投资这件事情的认知变化，以及哪些东西能够被吸收到我们自己的投资体系里。

🔗原文：https://t.co/gf3dlHePtN

1⃣作者这三年里经历了怎样的认知变化？

2023 年｜50 亿至 150 亿美元估值

最开始看不懂，主要受到 FOMO 驱动。反复研究技术材料、找 GP 和专家交流，最终才逐渐建立理解。当时甚至不敢相信估值未来还有百倍空间。

2024 年｜约 350 亿美元估值

随着 Claude 3.5 Sonnet 等产品表现，以及推理模型带来的行业突破，作者开始确认 Anthropic 能长期留在前沿模型竞争中。Coding 的差异化优势逐渐显现，投资信心明显提高。

2025 年｜约 600 亿美元估值

公司竞争地位逐渐得到验证，作者持续研究新的融资材料、调整收入预测，同时开始认识到云计算巨头不是单纯的竞争对手，还能成为算力和渠道伙伴。

2026 年｜ARR 出现爆发式增长

Anthropic 年化收入从 2025 年 12 月的 90 亿美元，增长至 2026 年 1 月 140 亿、2 月 200 亿、3 月 300 亿美元，增长速度远远超过他此前的预期。

2⃣Momentum（增长动量），是我认为全文最有价值的投资思考。

我倾向于把 Momentum 分成两种：一种是经营驱动的，一种是资本驱动的。

币圈尤其擅长制造后者，通过币价上涨吸引资本、扩大 TVL、强化市场共识，整个过程甚至不需要产生多少真实收入。

两种 Momentum 在牛市中的表现可能非常相似，但在外部资本停止供给之后，企业能否继续增长，才是检验其含金量的时候。

3⃣研究一个行业，最重要的是找到真正决定胜负的评价标准。

作者早期花了大量时间研究模型跑分、上下文长度、训练方法，却没有意识到 Coding 会成为如此巨大的商业市场。

当时他觉得全球写代码的人才多少个，市场天花板应该不高。

但实际上，AI Coding 的市场规模并不取决于现在有多少程序员，而取决于当软件生产成本大幅下降之后，社会愿意创造多少软件。

这也是研究新兴行业最容易犯的错误：用旧生产力条件下的需求规模，去估算新生产力条件下的市场空间。

我觉得真正有价值的行业研究，不仅要找到当下的北极星指标，还要提前判断这个指标什么时候会失效，下一个决定竞争格局的指标又是什么。

4⃣幂律效应（Power Law）之下，持续加仓的能力可能比早期发现的能力更重要。

很多 VC 在种子轮就投中了伟大的公司，却因为基金规模、持仓限制和资金期限，无法在后续融资中继续扩大敞口。

当企业真正进入价值创造最快的阶段时，他们反而失去了继续下注的能力。

资本的期限本身就是一种 Alpha。

普通投资者其实也一样，只不过限制我们的更多时候是心理成本。

很多投资者之间的收益差距，未必完全来自认知水平，而是来自资金结构、持有期限和承担波动的能力。

5⃣如何区分投资中的运气与能力？

这也是作者在文章最后留给自己的一个问题。

作者认为影响投资最大的人性弱点有四个：FOMO、怕贵、卖飞、不愿意否定过去的自己。

OPENAI'S MODELS JUST WENT FROM 58% TO 84% ON A DRUG DISCOVERY BENCHMARK IN ONE GENERATION.

It's called MedChemBench.

99 real medicinal chemistry problems, pulled from 117 papers and patents.

The kind of reasoning scientists use to decide which molecules are worth turning into medicine.

GPT 5.6 Sol: 58%.

GPT 6.2 Astra: 84.5%.

That's a 26 point jump between model generations.

Here's my take.

This is the AI story that actually matters.

Not chatbots. Not image generators.

Drug discovery takes about 10 years and over a billion dollars per drug.

Most candidates fail.

If AI can help scientists kill bad ideas earlier and spot good ones faster, that's years and lives saved.

But read the fine print too.

There's no human chemist score to compare against.

Only OpenAI's own models were tested.

And they may have seen the source papers during training.

So it's a strong signal, not a cure.

I'd love to see Claude and Gemini run the same test.

That's when we'll know who's actually ahead.

text:
Crypto hacks digest, Nov 22

1. Chainflip: the vault exploit is bigger than first thought. Chainflip confirmed BTC was also taken and offered the attacker a 10% bounty to return 90% by Nov 23. The BTC vault reportedly lost 122.86 BTC, which puts the total near $12M. The attacker reportedly registered a validator the day before. This is reportedly the protocol's second exploit in about 10 weeks.

2. Cyber bridge: 5.21M CYBER (~$1.1M) was minted on Solana without backing, and the same amount left the Ethereum lockbox two minutes later. The attacker reportedly dumped it for ~575 ETH. Upbit and Bithumb suspended CYBER deposits and withdrawals.

3. Fluidkey post-mortem: ~$1.6M was taken from 52 accounts across 6 chains through two unpatched flaws in a self-hosted SigNoz logging instance. Stolen session tokens let the attacker stage transfers that users' apps then signed. Keys never left users' devices. Transfer requests now need the user's own key.

4. Binance hack laundering: Elliptic reportedly says about $860M in ETH moved out of five major attacker wallets in four days, and at least $149M in BTC went through mixers.

5. An exploiter reportedly sold 5,270 ETH at $1,805, then bought back in with limit orders at $1,551–1,568. They now hold a ~$23.8M ETH long that is up $2.13M.

Attackers compromised an official Ledger reseller and stole funds from 1,486 user addresses between October 7 and 9. Tether froze $10M. The rest was scattered, including 25,017 ETH that went into Tornado.

3. Binance's $6.4B hack: where the money went. 

According to @somaxbt , token issuers have frozen $2.82B. The attacker still holds $2.67B: 18,270 BTC that have never moved, plus 335K ETH spread across 28 fresh wallets. Funds are being swapped to BTC through THORChain and then run through CoinJoin. @elliptic data puts 2,310+ BTC in CoinJoin so far. Reportedly only $32M has actually been recovered. 

4. @zachxbt unmasks the phisher behind @delusional. 

He says this person runs phishing through Google Ads and once pulled off a $55M drain. ZachXBT describes him as a US-based actor from The Com who goes by "Single". The @delusional account has since been deactivated. The threat actor also seems to be posting his photos from Florida.

5. Reental / RNT Lend (Polygon), update. 

Losses from the admin-key exploit are now estimated at about $955K, up from the ~$454K in the Nov 19 digest. That figure is reported only; there's no official confirmation yet. 

Stay safe!

text:
🚨 GCSA Insight | Valid Signature Drained the Vault. AI Found the Bug in 11 Minutes.

Three incidents, same pattern.

Chainflip lost $4.86M from its Ethereum vault plus 122.86 BTC. The signature checked out against the live threshold key. The nonce didn’t. It was a 39-digit outlier — the only one in nearly 300,000 accepted signatures that broke the sequential count. The vault paid anyway.

Cyber saw 5.21 million CYBER minted on Solana with no matching outbound message, then the same amount released from the Ethereum lockbox two minutes later. Roughly $1.1M left the reserves. The bridge executed what it was told.

MONAI Label: Cairn agents mapped the API, found a path traversal, and wrote arbitrary files in about 11 minutes. Later they planted a reverse shell in sitecustomize .py and triggered a training endpoint. Root on a university server. No advisory existed when they started. CVE-2026-133968, default auth off, fix still not on PyPI.

The check passed. The operation was still wrong.

Signature verification, message delivery, and “no known vulnerability” are not the same as trust. The failure sat outside the boundary the system actually enforced — key provenance, message legitimacy, or the assumption that a zero-day wouldn’t be found and used in one session.

$FIONA isn't just backed by a hippo that went viral in the U.S. Fiona has accumulated nearly a decade of genuine emotional connection.

B34nXKzCgsJb9ChLuSHPRpXLE3WFSWyeT8Cqkzzmpump 

In 2017, she was born as a premature baby hippo weighing only 29 pounds and initially even faced a fight for survival, but ultimately grew up under the care of Cincinnati Zoo staff. Many people went from worrying about whether she would survive to continuously watching her grow. Fiona gradually went from being a hippo in a zoo to a shared memory for Cincinnati locals.

Now that she has passed away, that accumulated emotion has been released all at once: local fans mourned her at games, public spaces in the city lit up with memorial lights, the U.S. Senate passed a memorial resolution, and Macy's also confirmed it will pay tribute to her at the 100th Thanksgiving Day Parade.

This shows that Fiona's influence has gone beyond that of an ordinary viral animal, forming a strong local identity in Cincinnati and possessing a certain level of recognition and emotional reach in other parts of the U.S.

For me, the cultural emotion Fiona truly carries is people's goodwill toward fragile life, the companionship through the process of growing up, and the shared remembrance after losing a familiar presence. In the past, everyone hoped she would grow up healthy; now, everyone hopes she will be remembered. This gives her story a complete emotional trajectory from birth, growth, to farewell. Compared with animal memes that rely purely on cute imagery for spread, Fiona has real experiences, long-term followers, and public memorial events as support, thus giving her the foundation to become a cultural symbol.

So FIONA's role is to let a shared memory that truly existed continue to be part of internet culture.

author: cfm_sol
quoted_text:
$FIONA may be worth watching in the current market. It combines a real-world animal story, a charitable mechanism, and strong social media traction.

B34nXKzCgsJb9ChLuSHPRpXLE3WFSWyeT8Cqkzzmpump 

What makes FIONA interesting isn't simply that it's riding on a real animal-related news event. It brings together three elements: an animal with existing global recognition, a sudden tragic event, and an active donation mechanism. This gives it an emotional connection and a real-world purpose that most animal memecoins lack. It's also why I've consistently emphasized narratives that combine real-world events with animals.

Fiona was one of the most famous hippos at the Cincinnati Zoo. She was born six weeks prematurely in 2017, weighing only around 29 pounds. After receiving intensive care from the zoo, she miraculously survived and eventually became a global internet sensation.

In mid-November, a visitor accidentally dropped a knitted hat into her habitat. Fiona swallowed it and underwent several days of treatment, but ultimately passed away from complications on November 19. Given her existing global recognition, the news triggered a wave of public attention and emotional engagement. This became the most direct catalyst behind FIONA's rally.

Another key differentiator is its charitable mechanism. According to the Pumpfun page, 100% of Creator Rewards is allocated to the Zoological Society of Cincinnati. The dashboard currently records approximately 810.38 SOL, worth around $58,144.90, in cumulative donations, with another 18.82 SOL remaining unclaimed.

I think this gives FIONA a more meaningful reason to spread than most animal memecoins. It's not just turning Fiona's image into a tradable token; it's attempting to convert creator rewards generated through trading activity into donations for animal protection. The growing donation amount can also become a recurring narrative catalyst, encouraging the community to keep Fiona's story and the zoo in the spotlight.

The X Engagement data provides another indication of market attention. Mentions across the reported intervals over the past 7 hours were 184, 328, 251, 134, 86, 20, and 40, adding up to approximately 1,043 mentions. Over the past 7 days, daily mentions were 3.4K, 2.7K, 4K, 4.3K, 5.6K, 4.3K, and 3.3K, totaling approximately 27.6K, with a daily peak of 5.6K.

This suggests that FIONA has attracted sustained social traction rather than experiencing just a brief spike in attention immediately after the news broke.

My take is that FIONA has already established an emotional narrative through a real-world event, while its charity mechanism gives that attention somewhere meaningful to go. However, social engagement still needs to translate into sustained community participation and organic buying demand. A high mention count alone doesn't prove that fresh capital is continuing to flow into the token.

The market is essentially betting on three things: whether Fiona's existing global recognition can continue generating attention; whether donations keep growing and build credibility through transparent on-chain records; and whether the community can turn a single tragic event into a longer-term narrative around remembrance and animal protection.

The main upside catalysts from here are continued growth in donations, public confirmation that the zoo or relevant organization has received the funds, and further coverage of Fiona's story by animal welfare communities and mainstream media. In particular, independent confirmation of the actual donations would be a stronger signal than another increase in X mentions.

My view is that FIONA already has three layers of support: a real-world event, emotional appeal, and a working charitable mechanism. Its narrative is more developed than that of a typical animal memecoin. The approximately 27.6K mentions over the past week also indicate meaningful social traction.

The risks are equally clear. Fiona has passed away, so the project no longer has a living animal character capable of continuously generating fresh content. The initial wave of news-driven attention could fade quickly. If donation growth stalls, the differentiation provided by the 100% Creator Rewards mechanism could gradually lose its impact.

On top of that, thin liquidity remains one of the biggest risks. High trading activity does not necessarily mean strong liquidity or sustainable demand, and limited market depth can amplify downside volatility when early holders begin taking profits.

据彭博社报道，高盛交易部门表示，随着美股周五大跌，该行恐慌指数升至 9，接近满分 10，显示未来一周市场仍可能面临新一轮大规模抛售。

高盛估算，商品交易顾问（CTA）等动量型交易者过去一个月已卖出约 570 亿美元股票，其美股净头寸已转为约 190 亿美元净空头。

该行模型预计，未来一周即使市场横盘，CTA 仍可能再抛售约 658 亿美元股票；若股市上涨，预计抛售规模约为 286 亿美元；若股市继续下跌，抛售规模最高可能达到 806 亿美元。

text:
🟢 OVERBLOWN: Ghostscript (Upload2Shell)
CVE-2026-125396 · 8.5 v4
Real bug, real fix, but the "every upload box" hype outruns the risk.

Why it's overblown:
▪️ Not on CISA KEV; no in-the-wild exploitation reported
▪️ 8.5 v4 / 7.8 v3.1, local attack vector; EPSS 0.16%
▪️ Public PoC only proves memory control, runs no command; full RCE chains unpublished
▪️ Needs untrusted PS/EPS/PDF to reach Ghostscript (upload thumbnails, open CUPS queues)
▪️ Fixed in Ghostscript 10.08.0 since Sep 8

When to patch:
▪️ Routine: 10.08.0 or your distro fix in the normal cycle; rebuild containers
▪️ Sooner: within days if uploads, attachments or print jobs reach Ghostscript via Pillow, ImageMagick or CUPS
▪️ Urgent: now if a full exploit chain goes public or it lands on KEV

Real: researchers ran commands via Roundcube, WordPress plugin forms, MediaWiki and open CUPS in specific setups.

We'll post again if it hits CISA KEV or gets rescored higher.
#CVE #infosec

text:
Grand Theft Auto 6 is the greatest piece of digital art ever made, and the best video game of all time

On top of that, it has so many technical breakthroughs it’s impossible to describe

Every scene and location has a level of detail my brain can’t comprehend

Do not listen to the stone cold morons who somehow made this game political. It isn’t a political game. Everyone is made fun of equally. There is no secretive political messaging

As a technologist I am absolutely blown away by what was achieved in this game. The graphical detail is exponentially better than any other piece of software in history. And it’s running on a 5 year old hardware (Xbox Series X)

Every square inch of this epically massive fictional Florida feels like it was handmade with love. No plot of dirt in this game feels hastily placed. No parking lot feels generic or barren. Every asset was handled with care and intention

I have a $10,000 PC with an RTX 5090 in it. I have yet to see it run anything close to the graphical or technical fidelity of this game

I don’t care if you play video games or not. If you are into technology you should be studying what was achieved by @RockstarGames  . There are technical breakthroughs that have completely revolutionized how GPU’s are used. 

From a gameplay perspective it’s the perfect modernization of the GTA formula. No you can’t steal any car or use any weapon at the beginning of the game. But this is a good thing. 

Modern video games all now heavily emphasize progression. Every game is basically an action RPG now. By slow dripping progression and making you feel more powerful as the game goes on, Rockstar carefully took a 20 year old formula and made it match and exceed 2026 standards. This game would have been significantly more boring with way less longevity if you had every car and gun available to you right away like in the classic games. 

The power scaling is glorious. Every time you unlock a new feature, whether it’s stealing more powerful cars, getting your own garage, or being able to afford a new weapon, you feel a sense of satisfaction you can only feel in a masterpiece Rockstar sandbox. 

If you are on the fence (which my guess would be is basically nobody) or were put off by the fake intellectuals on X who found ways to hate this game, ignore them. Just get it. Experience the digital magic. Appreciate the technology. 

10/10

text:
Why do HEPH machines use USDG, not ETH?

A robot doesn't speculate. It pays for electricity, parking, compute and data, and all of those are priced in dollars. Here's why that matters.

1. LIMITS NEED A STABLE UNIT

On HEPH, every machine has a spending cap. A delivery robot might be allowed $50 a day.

If that cap were set in ETH, the real limit would change every hour with the price. A cap that's safe on Monday could be too tight or too loose by Friday.

In USDG, $50 means $50. Today, tomorrow, every day.

2. OPERATORS NEED PREDICTABLE BOOKS

A fleet operator needs to know what each machine earned and spent. Revenue and costs in a volatile asset turn simple accounting into a mess of price conversions. In USDG, a charging session that costs $0.80 shows up as $0.80.

3. MACHINES SHOULDN'T HOLD VOLATILE ASSETS

A machine in the field is a target. It should hold only what it needs to operate, in an asset that won't swing while it sits there. Anything above its operating reserve is swept to the owner's vault automatically.

4. REGULATED, FULLY BACKED, REDEEMABLE

USDG is issued by Paxos. It is regulated by the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS), and in the EU it is MiCA-compliant through an e-money institution supervised by Finland's FIN-FSA.

It is backed by US dollar deposits, short-term US government securities and cash equivalents, and redeemable 1:1 for US dollars.

5. NATIVE ON ROBINHOOD CHAIN

USDG is the only native stablecoin on Robinhood Chain, and holds roughly two-thirds of stablecoin value on the network. Native means minted directly on the chain, not a bridged IOU from somewhere else. One less layer of risk.

It is backed by the Global Dollar Network, which includes Robinhood, Anchorage Digital, Worldpay, Mastercard and Fiserv.

6. NO GAS TOKEN, NO STRANDED MACHINES

Blockchains charge fees in ETH. A machine that runs out of ETH stops working, even with plenty of dollars in its wallet.

On HEPH, HephPaymaster sponsors the gas and bills it in USDG. The machine never touches ETH.

text:
有朋友问，连黎曼猜想都被AI证明了，数学是不是快到大结局了？

别，话别先说太满，只是进展确实非常迅猛，但是最终离确认还差那么几步。昨天11月20日，数学家Levent Alpöge在自己的网站上贴出一份四页的说明，说他相信，自己和Claude一起找到了黎曼猜想的证明，同时公布了约一千七百万行Lean形式化代码。今天21日，Lean和Mathlib社区发表联合声明，说命题的表述和证明都是对的，他们对此有充分的信心。几十个人各自编译，几种不同语言写的独立检查器各自核过，结果一致。Alpöge是Anthropic的数学家。他在说明里写，策略是他定的，可到了最后一段，Claude远远跑在了他前面；完整写出来超过二十五万页，所以只发了代码；证明里用到的一部分数学，他自己也还谈不上精通；他的直觉是，这个证明会被大幅简化，他还要把它理解透，再好好写出来。

首先这件事值得认真对待。该归给Alpöge的贡献归给Alpöge，该归给Claude的贡献，也可以大方归给Claude。可数学家们的反应，已经把问题说出来了。Maynard说，他有九成八九的把握它是对的，可核验未必能告诉我们它为什么成立。陶哲轩说，弄懂它需要时间。Conrad更不客气，说发表一个自己还没完全弄懂的证明，简直离谱。三个人说的，其实是一件事：检验已经完成了，理解还没有开始。

我想举个很简单的例子。从1加到10000，可以一项一项加，最后得到50005000，每一步都对，结果也对。也可以换个看法，1和10000配成一对，2和9999配成一对，每一对都是10001，一共5000对，乘一下，答案就出来了。就结果对不对来说，两种方法没有差别；对人来说，差别很大。前一种完成了计算，后一种让我们看见了配对的结构，知道为什么这样算，还能推到从1加到任何一个数，首项加末项，乘以项数，再除以二。真不真，不是不重要；可对人来说，为什么真，更重要。

所以是不是大结局，我想分三方面说。

首先，数学本身其实根本没有大结局。哥德尔的不完备定理说，一个一致的、公理能机械地列出来的、足够表达基本算术的形式系统，证不完所有真的算术命题。人用这样的系统，AI也用这样的系统，受的是同一个限制。加一条公理，能解决旧问题，新系统又会有自己证不了的命题。

其次，真命题的无限，也不是人必须无限追赶的义务。一个命题是真的，不会自动要求谁花时间去研究它。我们关心它，是因为它让我们看见一种关系，一种结构，得到一种能力，或者打开一个值得继续问的问题，也可以就是弄懂它的那份乐趣。写AI时代尊严那篇我说，一个人放不下的那一份，是他认定怎样活才算活得好，为此没有回报也要做的事。对很多人来说，数学就是这样一件事。机器证得再快，也拿不走一个人弄懂一样东西时的那一下。

第三方面，也是我认为最紧要的，是人不要在看向数学，而是要让数学转向认识的人。康德在《纯粹理性批判》第二版序言里说，以往总以为我们的认识必须依照对象，不妨试一试，假定对象必须依照我们的认识。他举的头一个例子就是数学：第一个证明等腰三角形性质的人，心里亮了一下，他明白了，不能只盯着那个图形看，要把自己按概念放进去的东西，重新造出来。借这个思路，今天可以问的，是一个已经被证明的结果，怎样成为人能掌握、能讲清、能接着往前走的认识。这不是要真理迁就某个人今天的理解，结论可以先承认，理解它的形式，可以慢慢找；人的认识，也可以被新的概念、新的写法撑大。

AI在这里当然也可以帮忙，帮着证明，也帮着解释和简化，没有必要提前规定，哪一种活永远只能由人来做。写《涵育，不是训练》的时候我说，同一个工具，两个方向。它可以让人从此不必想，也可以让人想得更远。教育论里我说，教育不是把人教会，而是让人不被教死。数学也一样，要紧的不是答案有没有，而是人还在不在思考。

从1一项一项加到10000，和看见10001乘以5000，和是一样的。变化发生在认识的人那里，我们终于看见了那个关系。黎曼猜想的证明，也许已经完成了；而人对它的认识，也可以才刚刚开始。
